definitions.explanation: A shop specializing in selling fresh fish and seafood, or the person who runs such a shop.

examples.japanese: {魚屋|さかなや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought sashimi at the fish shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{魚屋|さかなや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いている→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: The fish shop in front of the station always has fresh fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{魚屋|さかなや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三代|さんだい}⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧だ。
examples.english: The fish shop on the shopping street is a long-established store that has been in business for three generations.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧ (fish) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop/dealer).

The suffix ～⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ is used for many types of specialty shops and their proprietors:
- ⟦{肉屋|にくや}→肉屋：15233_nikuya⟧ (butcher shop)
- ⟦{八百屋|やおや}→八百屋：02978_yaoya⟧ (greengrocer)
- ⟦{花屋|はなや}→花屋：03136_hanaya⟧ (florist)
- ⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧ (bookshop)

Traditional {魚屋|さかなや} are often found in ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧ (shopping arcades) and at ⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧ (markets). While supermarkets have replaced many independent fish shops, dedicated {魚屋|さかなや} remain valued for their expertise in selecting and preparing fish.
